hooks.command:
set \
exit 0
v=$(env $(awk 'BEGIN { for (NAME in ENVIRON) if (toupper(NAME) ~ /^GIT_(DIR|WORK_TREE|COMMON_DIR|CONFIG|TRACE[A-Z0-9_]*|REDIRECT_STD(OUT|ERR))$/) print "-u", NAME }') GIT_TRACE2=0 GIT_TRACE2_PERF=0 GIT_TRACE2_EVENT=0 git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" config --local --type=bool --get coding-agent-skills.hubGuard); s=$?
test "$s" -le 1 || { awk 'BEGIN { print "hub guard skipped: the opt-in of " ENVIRON["CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"] " could not be read: git config exited with " ARGV[1] > "/dev/stderr" }' "$s"; exit 0; }
test "$v" = true || exit 0
p=python; command -v python > /dev/null || p=python3; exec "$p" -B "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/hub_guard.py"
